exports.signature: fn parse_input(input: proc_macro::TokenStream, kind: DeriveKind) -> DeriveResult<DeriveInput>
exports.behavior: Parses and validates all container, field, and variant attributes; preserves original tokens and source spans; strips generic defaults only from impl generics; assigns dense non-skipped slots.
Emits an inherent JMAX_DEFINITION_VARIANTS constant with ordered static string, i32, and description tuples, retaining the where clause and escaping all string values.
